journey.name: Retired Plan Moves Report
journey.description: Validates that administrators can inspect an audit report of stores migrated off retired plans to Pro, filter by store ID, view transition timestamps, and follow links from the merchant details page.

story.title: List subscriptions moved off retired plans
Filter retired plan audit entries by store
Merchant detail link to retired plan move record

actions.action: Sign in to the Admin Dashboard and navigate to '/dashboard/billing/operations'.
Scroll to the 'Subscriptions Moved off Retired Plans' section.
Verify the audit table displays columns for Merchant ID, Previous Plan, New Plan, Date, and Actions.
Verify that when no subscriptions have been moved, the empty state displays 'No subscriptions moved off retired plans' rather than a blank table.
Enter a Tenant ID in the search input and click 'Filter' to filter records for that merchant.
Navigate to '/dashboard/merchants/{tenantId}' for a migrated merchant.
Verify a notice banner informs support that the store was moved from a retired plan, with a link to view the move record in Billing Operations.
